figures.claim: The anterior drawer measures anterior translation of the tibia on the femur with the knee flexed to about ninety degrees.

The ninety degree position is where the posterior drawer, the posterior sag and the rotational modifications are all performed, so the position is efficient even if the anterior test within it is weak.
